changes.authenticatedUrl: Preserves caller path/query/fragment; plugin continues passing only validated clean HTTPS root.
changes.nativeRedirect: 303 Location changed from / to ./; browser acceptance must resolve the clean root.
changes.admission: admit(request) returns operator PeerAdmission after existing Host/Origin/browser authentication; not an external OIDC authenticator.
changes.requestEvent: connection/request waterfall is after native authentication and covers shared API HTTP, not every owner or WebSocket.
changes.websocket: Gateway uses admit(request) and appReady before mux registration. Proxy check remains mandatory.
changes.credentials: CredentialProvider.resolve interface unchanged; account-platform additions do not authenticate Web OIDC users.
changes.webServer: Exact route registration/disposal unchanged; multipart compression added.
